output.question: What is Palantir's stock split history?
output.answer: Palantir Technologies (Nasdaq: PLTR) has never split its stock, according to sources checked as of November 2026. StockSplitHistory.com lists 0 splits for PLTR and an empty split table. A Motley Fool article from October 24, 2026 says 'Palantir has yet to conduct a stock split across its roughly six-year history as a publicly traded company.' One search result showed a roic.ai page for a different ticker, PLTR.NE, with a 4:1 split dated 2025-11-14. That page returned 403 when I tried to open it, so I couldn't confirm it, and it doesn't refer to the Nasdaq PLTR common stock.

key_facts.fact: Palantir Technologies (PLTR) has had 0 stock splits, and the PLTR split history table has no entries.
Palantir has not split its stock in roughly six years as a public company.
The Fool.com quote box showed PLTR at $173.17 (+2.58%) at 1:00 PM ET on 11/11/26. The article body describes the stock as 'roughly $200 per share.'

passages.quote: According to our Palantir Technologies stock split history records, Palantir Technologies has had 0 splits.
Palantir has yet to conduct a stock split across its roughly six-year history as a publicly traded company.

caveats: A search snippet for roic.ai's PLTR.NE page (a separate, non-Nasdaq listing, probably a Canadian depositary receipt) showed a 4:1 split on 2025-11-14. The page returned 403, so this is unverified. It would not be a split of Palantir's Nasdaq common stock either way.
Neither page is a primary company source. A company announcement of a split after these pages were last updated cannot be ruled out, though the October 2026 article says none has happened.
Split speculation, such as a split becoming likely if the stock nears $500, is commentary and not a company plan.
